+"""Directed, margin-preserving codebook geometry auxiliary loss."""
+
+import torch
+import torch.nn.functional as F
+
+
+def mechanism_loss(source, target, codebook, mask, **parameters):
+    """Compute directed soft-assignment overlap plus expected-distance margin loss."""
+    tau = parameters.get("tau", 0.2)
+    tau_a = parameters.get("tau_a", 0.35)
+    epsilon = parameters.get("epsilon", 1e-8)
+    margin = parameters.get("margin", 0.08)
+    mu = parameters.get("mu", 0.05)
+    weight = parameters.get("lambda", parameters.get("lambda_", 0.01))
+
+    # Target uses the ordinary assignment; source uses a separately tempered,
+    # directional assignment. Keeping these roles distinct is intentional.
+    target_logits = -torch.cdist(target, codebook).square() / tau
+    source_logits = -torch.cdist(source, codebook).square() / tau
+    p_target = F.softmax(target_logits, dim=-1)
+    q_source = F.softmax(source_logits / tau_a, dim=-1)
+
+    overlap = (p_target * q_source).sum(dim=-1)
+    code_dist_sq = torch.cdist(codebook, codebook).square()
+    expected_distance = torch.einsum("bc,bk,ck->b", p_target, q_source, code_dist_sq)
+    per_pair = -torch.log(epsilon + overlap) + mu * F.relu(margin - expected_distance)
+
+    weights = mask.to(device=per_pair.device, dtype=per_pair.dtype)
+    # Mask before reduction; empty masks therefore yield exact zero without division.
+    return weight * (per_pair * weights).mean()

+"""Directed, margin-preserving codebook geometry auxiliary loss."""
+
+import torch
+import torch.nn.functional as F
+
+
+def mechanism_loss(source, target, codebook, mask, **parameters):
+    """Compute directed soft-assignment overlap plus expected-distance margin loss."""
+    tau = parameters.get("tau", 0.2)
+    tau_a = parameters.get("tau_a", 0.35)
+    epsilon = parameters.get("epsilon", 1e-8)
+    margin = parameters.get("margin", 0.08)
+    mu = parameters.get("mu", 0.05)
+    weight = parameters.get("lambda", parameters.get("lambda_", 0.01))
+
+    # Target uses the ordinary assignment; source uses a separately tempered,
+    # directional assignment. Keeping these roles distinct is intentional.
+    target_logits = -torch.cdist(target, codebook).square() / tau
+    source_logits = -torch.cdist(source, codebook).square() / tau
+    p_target = F.softmax(target_logits, dim=-1)
+    q_source = F.softmax(source_logits / tau_a, dim=-1)
+
+    overlap = (p_target * q_source).sum(dim=-1)
+    code_dist_sq = torch.cdist(codebook, codebook).square()
+    expected_distance = torch.einsum("bc,bk,ck->b", p_target, q_source, code_dist_sq)
+    per_pair = -torch.log(epsilon + overlap) + mu * F.relu(margin - expected_distance)
+
+    weights = mask.to(device=per_pair.device, dtype=per_pair.dtype)
+    # Mask before reduction; empty masks therefore yield exact zero without division.
+    return weight * (per_pair * weights).mean()
